name: @bolle/web-components
description: A material based web component library

scripts.build: npm run typography && npm run typecheck && vite build && tsc --emitDeclarationOnly && cp src/tokens.css src/design-system.json dist/
scripts.build:site: npm run typography && vite build --config vite.site.config.ts
scripts.colors: rolldown scripts/colors.mjs --platform node --format esm -o node_modules/.cache/colors.mjs && node node_modules/.cache/colors.mjs
scripts.format: prettier --write src demo index.html package.json tsconfig.json vite.config.ts
